name: bootstrap_citizens_quests
description: Tier-1/2 reference game with the intro quests (golden y): the plan of bootstrap_citizens in the same order, with a claim_quest step as soon as a quest of the intro chain is completed (goods to the start island) and every wait shortened to the whole minutes the plan needs. The quest rewards are the only change; island 2 is founded at minute 44 and the first Citizen house stands at minute 73.
